title: Credit and Debt Management
introduction: Explore credit and debt management using everyday examples.
definition: Credit permits payment later and creates an obligation to repay. Debt is money owed. Compare the total instalments and any fees with the cash price, and plan repayments within a budget.

examples.question: Cash price RM300; credit plan is six payments of RM55.

exercises.question: Cash RM200, credit total RM230. Extra RM?
Does unpaid credit create debt? yes/no
